location_lifecycle.label: Location Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a physical location. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.label: Planned
planned.help: The location is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.label: Operational
operational.help: The location is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.label: Under Maintenance
under_maintenance.help: The location is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.label: Temporarily Closed
temporarily_closed.help: Operations are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.label: Closed
closed.help: Operations have ended at this location.
